dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Oh, hello! May I ask if there is anything I might help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: To be frank, myself and my admirable colleagues have already... uh...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: We have completed compiling the data with an efficiency that astonishes even ourselves. And our findings have already been submitted for review.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Our department supervisor was overjoyed to approve, and without even a glance he drew a big circle on the report to indicate he had reviewed it and passed it on up the chain...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: After all, the approval of something like this cannot be decided by our supervisor alone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope it all goes smoothly...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: And I wish you a safe journey.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How long will it take, approximately?

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Hmm. If all goes well, about three months or so. But if, as expected, the unexpected happens, then it's hard to say.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: You see, a request like this requires approval from the Maison Gestion. And I would imagine you've heard tell of just how... efficient... those gentlemen are?

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: As you can see, I am conscientiously fulfilling my professional obligations.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: You see, the supervisor has approved my transfer request. So, in principle, at least...

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: I am no longer a researcher at the Department of Hydrology and Aquatic Life Conservation. And naturally that means I no longer need to go to the office.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: Also, as the Maison Gestion has not yet granted its approval, I am not yet officially an employee of the Hydrology Monitoring Station... The entire department has been dissolved.

dialogues.speaker: Broglie
dialogues.text: And therefore, due to the restrictions thus imposed by outside conditions, all I can do now is arrange some work for myself. *sigh* There's nothing I can do about it...
